note: The Guyana Bank for Trade and Industry (GBTI): its Visa credit card application form (October 2026) gives each card's fees in US dollars, and its Visa Classic and Visa Gold pages give the interest, so the cards are written in US dollars. Each card: 2% a month on the utilized balance (the pages' fee table sets this figure against the annual fee row, one row out of line; it is read as the interest the pages call the cards' 'same competitive rates'); the annual fee from the form, US$35 for the Classic and US$50 for the Gold; the form's US$25 late payment fee and US$25 over limit fee (the pages say there are no over-limit fees; the form, the later document and the one the holder signs, is written). The Visa Platinum (US$100 a year on the form) has no page stating its interest and isn't written, nor is the Mastercard Gold, whose page gives its fees (US$50 a year, a cash advance fee of 2%, at least US$10, and a late fee of 1.5% of the minimum payment) but no interest rate. The co-applicant, replacement card and limit increase fees aren't written. The pages' '1/16 of balance (6.25% monthly interest)' is not clear enough to read as a minimum payment and isn't written; no grace period, foreign transaction fee or cash advance fee for the Visa cards is published.
